name: windrider-invoker-enter-removes-two-enlighten-draws-and-gains-power
notes: Windrider Invoker On Enter: removing two enlighten counters from the champion draws a card and gives +3 power. Pre-fix the counters were never removed (the champion MZ was an undefined variable) although the card was drawn and the power granted.

rulesClauses: On Enter: You may remove two enlighten counters from your champion. If you do, draw a card and Windrider Invoker gets +3 [POWER] until end of turn.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The Enter-1 handler read $champMZ, which was only defined in the enter body: RemoveCounters ran against an empty MZ, so the cost was never paid. The handler is overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php and looks the champion up itself.
